door: Meraxes door, hung on a port pintle. Pin r 3.6 mm, barrel bore r 4.2 mm. The leaf bolts to the aluminium skin. The head leaves 0.8 mm of lift. The door stops on the arms at about 127°.
note: The earlier pin sat in free air. This one carries the door. Ferrule presses are unchanged. Common volume elsewhere is zero.
